name: @jeldon/leads
description: Domain-agnostic lead pipeline maths: first-touch attribution (path-only landing, hostname-only referrer), lead channels via the shared referer classifier, lead trends with a date basis and a maturing flag, a views → leads → booked conversion map with low-sample flags, and a booking import that hashes identifiers the same way in browser and server. Mailbox response tracking lives in the opt-in `@jeldon/leads/compliance` subpath.
